proposals.name: Dusty slow nova reddening
proposals.idea: A slowly rising hot photosphere peaked in g about 25 days ago and then expanded and cooled. Dust then condensed while a cool, H-alpha-bright photosphere emerged, preferentially extinguishing g and producing the abrupt late reddening and r-band turn-on rather than a persistently blue TDE.

t_peak.meaning: time of hot blue photospheric peak

tau_rise.meaning: exponential rise time of hot component in days

tau_fall.meaning: intrinsic decline time of hot component in days

amp_hot_b.meaning: peak hot-component flux in each band in microjansky

w_dust.meaning: width in days of dust formation transition

tau_dust_b.meaning: dust optical depth in each band, expected larger in g than r

t_red.meaning: emergence time of cool red and H-alpha component

w_red.meaning: rise width in days of red component

tau_red_fall.meaning: slow decline time of red component in days

amp_red_b.meaning: red-component flux scale in each band in microjansky, expected much larger in r than g

proposals.predicts: Unlike a blue TDE, g will keep fading rapidly while r peaks days to weeks later and declines slowly, so g-r continues reddening by more than a magnitude with no blue rebrightening.

proposals.name: dust-forming stellar merger
proposals.idea: Expanding luminous-red-nova ejecta first produce a hot, weeks-long optical rise. After maximum the ejecta cool below the condensation temperature, rapidly forming dust that preferentially extinguishes the blue light while a cooler, redder photosphere emerges.

t_hot.meaning: age in days at hot-component maximum

t_cool.meaning: age in days at cool-component maximum

amp_hot_b.meaning: hot-component peak flux per band in microjansky

amp_cool_b.meaning: cool-component peak flux per band in microjansky

ext_b.meaning: dust optical depth per band, larger in g than r

proposals.predicts: The r band will show a delayed plateau or second maximum around and after now while g continues fading rapidly and the colour remains very red, unlike the persistently blue, slowly declining emission expected from a TDE.

proposals.name: Luminous red nova merger
proposals.idea: A Galactic stellar merger, consistent with the low Galactic latitude, produced a hot blue first peak from expanding ejecta that is now fading exponentially. As the ejecta cool, recombine and form dust, a second intrinsically red peak is emerging in r while the g-band continuum continues to fade.

helpers.hot_shape: exp(-max(t_peak - t, 0) / tau_rise - max(t - t_peak, 0) / tau_fade)
helpers.red_shape: (1 / (1 + exp(-(t - t_red) / tau_red))) * exp(-max(t - t_red, 0) / tau_red_decay)

t_peak.meaning: day of the first blue maximum

tau_rise.meaning: exponential rise time to first peak in days

tau_fade.meaning: exponential fade time of the blue ejecta in days

amp_hot_b.meaning: peak flux of the hot blue component in band b

t_red.meaning: onset day of the second red recombination peak

tau_red.meaning: rise width of the red peak in days

tau_red_decay.meaning: decay time of the red peak in days

amp_red_b.meaning: peak flux of the cool red component in band b

proposals.predicts: The r band will turn over and fade within about two weeks while remaining brighter and much redder than g, and g will keep fading exponentially rather than rebrightening to the TDE forecast.
